Process Overview
The Formally Designated Complaint Handling Unit is responsible for handlingpotentialproduct
complaints, including timely and uniform intake, evaluation, and investigation.
Medtronic employees who handle complaints maintain and reinforce local patient privacy regulations
throughout the complaint-handling process.

NOTES:

     submitting a regulatory report before completing analysis and investigation because of regulatory-
     reportingtimelines) or some steps may not be required (for example, no product analysis if no
     product is returned).
     Monitoring and evaluation of timeliness measures on a periodic and ongoing basisis performed per
     D00426291, Perform Management Review
     Monitoring and trending of complaints is performed per 034, Product Risk Management,byPost-
